headline: Verdash worker
title: Verdash | Five Jobs Plus Extra Jump | Palworld Guide
video_script: Verdash is a great all round worker in Palworld one point zero. It has Handiwork level five, Gathering level five and Planting level four, with Lumbering and Transporting at level three. Its partner skill gives you one extra jump and one extra mid air dash while it is in your party. Would you add it to your base? Comment below!
description: Verdash in Palworld 1.0 is a strong Grass worker with five work suitabilities and a mobility partner skill.
